headline: A 2012 executive order directs federal action on preventing and responding to violence against women and girls around the world.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets federal policy on preventing and responding to violence against women and girls in other countries. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and programs it covers cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Women and girls outside the United States
who_it_affects.how: They are the intended focus of US government efforts to prevent and respond to violence.
They would likely be directed to carry out the policy, though the source does not name which agencies.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 10, 2012; the source does not state a separate start date.
